finalText:
Greta Weiss, Paul Weiss and Nina Weiss (booking WN4R8C) are rebooked from the cancelled ZX 440 onto the connection ZX 470 → ZX 472, which reaches New York JFK at 18:40 on 9 November.

- **Greta (Business):** the only business-cabin option that works. ZX 470 had 2 business seats free and ZX 472 had 2; after the move both show 1 free.
- **Paul and Nina (Economy):** ZX 470 had 5 economy seats free and ZX 472 had 4; after the move they show 3 and 2.

I passed over the earlier option, ZX 450 → ZX 460 (arrives 17:55), because ZX 460 has no business seats free and Greta couldn't be moved onto it.

The app confirmed "Rebooked 3 passengers to ZX 470 → ZX 472". The passenger list on the connections screen now shows only the other passengers, so the three Weiss bookings are no longer listed as pending there.

conversation.content: Flight ZX 440 from Frankfurt (FRA) to New York (JFK) on 9 November is cancelled. Rebook the three passengers with booking reference WN4R8C together onto the connection that arrives in New York earliest and has a free seat in each passenger's cabin, for all three of them, on every flight. Everyone keeps their cabin.
